Choose boards with ALC1220 audio codec if possible

PCIe Gen 4.0: 850X
Gen 5.0: 8100
https://borecraft.com/

High-end: 9070 XT, 5070 Ti
Workstation: 7900XTX, 5090
AI: Radeon AI PRO R9700, blackwell 6000
